title.zh_cn: 皮兰港：武器与弹药后勤
title.en_us: Piran Port: Weapons and Ammunition Logistics

text.zh_cn: 收集和加工所需材料。在弹药工作台手动选择配方，生产对应武器的弹药。
text.en_us: Gather and process the required materials. Select a recipe manually at the ammo workbench to make compatible ammunition.

text.zh_cn: 在武器工作台制作武器本体。查看 JEI 确认原料、蓝图及具体配方。
text.en_us: Make the weapon at the weapon workbench. Consult JEI for materials, blueprints and individual recipes.

text.zh_cn: 将鱼雷发射器和足量同口径鱼雷放入再装填设施，等待装满后取出。并非所有武器都使用这台设施。
text.en_us: Put a torpedo launcher and enough matching-caliber torpedoes into the reload facility. Wait for a full load and retrieve it; not every weapon uses this facility.

text.zh_cn: 装满的发射器可以带上出航。弹药耗尽后回到补给环节，形成生产与装填循环。
text.en_us: Take the loaded launcher on sortie. When ammunition runs out, return to the supply steps and repeat the production and loading cycle.
